header.description: What: on basic-desert a BLUE stochastic platoon (30 men) and a RED stochastic squad (4 men - the weaker side) face each other 300 m apart, both defending; they fire on each other (agg-backend's phase A). Judge: (1) the fire reaches BOTH sides (a Blue man is hit; most of the Red squad is down); (2) suppression rises on both (AggregateUnit.SuppressedShare > 0); (3) the weaker side breaks first - a Red slot's stress reaches the break level before any Blue slot's does. NOT judged: 'losses inside the C-8 band' - the band needs the physical runs (agg-backend CE-8009, not built), so that row waits; no band is invented. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh agg-platoon-duel (Placed on basic-desert's FLAT ground north of the 9 m mound at y 200-220 - agg-backend R-4286: with F-19 a stochastic unit stands ON the terrain, and on the mound Blue was hull-down behind its crest.)
